text.tspan: Cooked a complicated recipe on a weeknight and
regretted the timing, not the food.
In Bengaluru, i prepped onions and sauces on
Sunday so Tuesday had a chance.

systems.
Leftovers got intentional names so they did
not feel like punishment.

on purpose.
